# relay_cloud_providers (Data Source)

Lists the cloud providers the platform serves, with their regions. `relay_regions` has the detail per region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_cloud_providers" "all" {}

output "served" {
  value = { for c in data.relay_cloud_providers.all.cloud_providers : c.name => c.regions }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `cloud_providers` (Attributes List) Cloud providers, ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_providers))

<a id="nestedatt--cloud_providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_providers`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Cloud provider, as `cloud` takes it elsewhere, for example `aws`.
- `regions` (List of String) Regions served, ordered.
